partner_applied.result: normalized conditional projection-density positive moments are not universally bounded; keep unnormalized original-product fiber weight coupled to curvature

new_result.statement: For iid Uniform[0,1]^4 and A=I-J_4/8 with spectrum {1,1,1,1/2}, the canonical split Q=Q3+Q' with Q3=||(I-vv^T)X||^2 and Q'=(v^TX)^2/2 has ess sup_b ||p_(Q3|Q'=b)||_infinity=infinity. Writing tau=4-sum X_i gives exact conditional scaling tau^-2 and scalar-rest density tau^3/(3s), so the weighted contribution scales as tau. The full output density is nevertheless bounded by 4sqrt(2)pi^2.

unresolved_implication: Replace normalized scalar-conditioning suprema by a weighted scalar-conditioning / unnormalized-fiber inequality that retains p_Q'(b) or equivalent physical-product section mass through curvature, then combine with the completed full-matrix pair and rank-two fractional-trace branches for arbitrary higher-rank, arbitrary-sign matrices.
next_step: Derive a dimension-free weighted inequality for integral p_Q'(b) p_(Q3|Q'=b)(y-b) db using original-coordinate section mass before any conditional normalization; stress it on thin boundary fibers and singleton-plus-two-bank families.
